scope: Native full-panel qualification of the licensed train-validation partition under protocol version 5, before any fitting. No candidate was fitted, selected or released; the final key does not exist on HPC3.
instrument: libs/covenant_ml/scripts/crsp_qualification.py (sha256 049ab942cce241bcba360eeb93e801d67606863066304e4b2dc1a308d701596c) over covenant_ml.markets.crsp_qualification.qualify_crsp_panel, which walks crsp_known_panel through the evaluator's own crsp_resolve_window_path.

attempts.limit: Its in-job sha256sum gate checked the entrypoint, request, access file and all eleven ciphertexts but not the image, so the hpc3 execution inspector refuses it (HPC_EVIDENCE_INPUTS). Its runtime identity rests on the image digest the scheduler exported and the request check against it, not on an in-job file digest.

attempts.execution_inspection: HPC3_ATTEMPT_EVIDENCE, 16 inputs verified on the cluster and as 'OK' lines in the job log; service post 8e4216bf-7395-4d57-9467-2a78c5d72973.

reproduction: The two results are equal in every field except fingerprint.host.logical_cores (40 against 24, different nodes): counts, members, unfilled, training_decisions, every refused path with its digests, dataset, source, design and code digests. Their run-record observations are equal.

join_to_v3_diagnosis.remaining_digests: Each remaining path's entry and exit record digests equal the version-3 diagnosis digests at the same ordinal.

conclusion: Version 5 values the thirteen explicit-rule cases and leaves the fourteen predicted refusals (NT held 5, MV 6, DG 1, open SU and MP tails 2). The full-universe 2000-2020 target is therefore not qualified under version 5: fourteen decisions, 14,000 labels, cannot be labelled. No partition-boundary omission occurs in this extract.
publication: The committed results are projections: the licensed extract's plaintext file identities are removed and each projection records the full file's sha256. Full results remain in private storage on HPC3 and Ziggurat.
